meta.title: Wuyong — Local MCP Resident Sub-Agent
meta.description: A resident sub-agent running as a local MCP / skill with high privileges. Discovers skills from skills.sh, manages the local skill pool, and tells the host agent which skill to use. Local-first routing: local → pool → online → none. Zero telemetry.

commands.doctor: Check environment and core skill status
commands.bootstrap: Initialize state, install find-skills, run first monitor sync
commands.hint: Decide a single user/thinking event and output a Decision JSON
commands.pool-list: List skills in the dynamic pool
commands.pool-sync: Sync the dynamic pool from skills.sh
commands.watch: Watch JSONL events from stdin and emit Decision per line
